project_metadata.ministry: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food & Public Distribution
project_metadata.title: Legal Metrology AI Compliance Engine — Statutory Framework & Legal Data Reference
project_metadata.framing: Pre-Inspection Compliance-Assist Screening Engine (Evidence-backed advisory tool, not a statutory notice)

four_governing_legal_regimes.scope: The parent statute governing weights, measures, standards, enforcement powers, offences, compounding, and penalties.

key_sections.section_15: Power of inspection, search, seizure. Strictly reserved for Director, Controller, or Legal Metrology Officers.
key_sections.section_18: Mandatory compliance for pre-packaged commodities (no sale unless declarations conform).
key_sections.section_36_1: Penalty for non-conforming declarations (1st offence: up to ₹25,000; 2nd: up to ₹50,000; Subsequent: ₹50,000–₹1,00,000 and/or 1 yr imprisonment).
key_sections.section_36_2: Penalty for error in net quantity (1st offence: ₹10,000–₹50,000; Subsequent: up to ₹1,00,000 and/or 1 yr imprisonment).
key_sections.section_53: Compounding of offences — Director/Controller may compound offences before or after institution of prosecution.

four_governing_legal_regimes.scope: The specific labelling and packaging standards checked by the engine against package labels.

key_rules.rule_3: Exemption conditions for packages > 25 kg/L, industrial/institutional, agricultural farm produce.
key_rules.rule_6: Mandatory declarations on retail pre-packaged commodities.
key_rules.rule_26: Specific exemptions including <= 10 g/ml packages (excluding tobacco products).
key_rules.rule_32: Prohibition of altering/erasing MRP and selling above declared MRP.

four_governing_legal_regimes.scope: Food-specific labelling running in parallel to PC Rules for food commodities.
governed_fields: Veg / Non-Veg logo (green/brown dot in square)
four_governing_legal_regimes.demarcation: A food product can pass FSSAI and fail Legal Metrology (or vice versa). FSSAI is a distinct parallel layer scoped separately from Legal Metrology PC Rules.

four_governing_legal_regimes.statute: Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (DPDP Act)
four_governing_legal_regimes.scope: Governs data collected by the application (photos of labels, addresses, phone numbers, officer user accounts).
obligations: Data Fiduciary responsibilities upon collecting user or business identifiable data
Purpose limitation (processing strictly for compliance audit)
No unnecessary data retention beyond audit session
Enforced independently by the Data Protection Board of India

rule_6_mandatory_declarations.field_name: Name and Complete Address of Manufacturer / Packer / Importer
rule_6_mandatory_declarations.legal_requirements: Complete name and address where the commodity is manufactured, packed, or imported. If manufacturer and packer are different, both or the packer must be clearly declared.
rule_6_mandatory_declarations.explanation_ii_rule: Under Explanation II to Rule 6, if a brand owner/marketer appears differently from manufacturer, liability attaches to whoever is named FIRST on the label.

rule_6_mandatory_declarations.field_name: Common or Generic Name of Commodity
rule_6_mandatory_declarations.legal_requirements: Generic name of commodity. If package contains two or more components/items, the declaration must state the separate components and quantities.

rule_6_mandatory_declarations.field_name: Net Quantity in Standard SI Units
rule_6_mandatory_declarations.legal_requirements: Net quantity in standard SI symbols: Weight in 'g', 'kg'; Volume in 'ml', 'l' / 'L'; or piece count 'N' / 'U'. Non-standard units like 'gm', 'gms', 'ML', 'kilo' are non-compliant.

rule_6_mandatory_declarations.field_name: Month and Year of Manufacture / Packing / Import
rule_6_mandatory_declarations.legal_requirements: Month and year of manufacture, packing, or pre-packing (e.g. MM/YYYY or Month YYYY).
Must say 'MRP Rs. ___ / ₹ ___ (inclusive of all taxes)' or 'MRP Rs. ___ / ₹ ___ (incl. of all taxes)'. Dual pricing stickers, smudging, or price alteration is strictly prohibited.
Name, address, telephone number, and email address of the person or office that can be reached in case of consumer complaints.

rule_6_mandatory_declarations.statutory_rule: Rule 6(1)(g) [2021 Amendment, in force from 1 Jan 2024]
rule_6_mandatory_declarations.legal_requirements: Price per unit of measure (e.g. ₹/g, ₹/kg, ₹/ml, ₹/l, ₹/piece) for packages > 1kg/1L. Not required if MRP equals unit sale price (e.g. 1 unit pack).
Country of origin must be prominently declared for all imported packages.

statutory_exemptions_rule_3_and_26.threshold: Net weight > 25 kg or volume > 25 litres (except cement and fertiliser which are exempt above 50 kg).
statutory_exemptions_rule_3_and_26.system_action: Mark as STATUTORY EXEMPT; waive retail declaration checks.

statutory_exemptions_rule_3_and_26.threshold: Agricultural farm produce packed in packages above 50 kg.
Packages marked 'Not for retail sale' meant for institutional/industrial consumption (hotels, hospitals, railways, airlines).
Net quantity is 10 g / 10 ml or less. CRITICAL EXCEPTION: Tobacco products are NEVER exempt even at <= 10g.
statutory_exemptions_rule_3_and_26.system_action: Check for tobacco keywords ('tobacco', 'gutkha', 'khaini', 'pan masala', 'bidi', 'cigarette'). If tobacco, DO NOT EXEMPT. If non-tobacco, mark STATUTORY EXEMPT.

statutory_exemptions_rule_3_and_26.threshold: Fast food packed by a restaurant or hotel for immediate customer consumption.
Scheduled and non-scheduled drug formulations regulated under Drugs (Price Control) Orders.
Loose garments and hosiery sold openly for consumer physical inspection prior to purchase.
statutory_exemptions_rule_3_and_26.system_action: Mark as STATUTORY EXEMPT / reduced declaration set.

enforcement_authority_and_case_law.governing_sections: Legal Metrology Act, 2009 — Section 15 (Powers of Director, Controller, and Officers)

supreme_court_benchmark.case_citation: ITC Ltd. v. State of Karnataka (2025 INSC 1111)
supreme_court_benchmark.ruling_principle: A Legal Metrology Officer cannot search or seize without a valid warrant and recorded 'reasons to believe'. Officers must strictly adhere to Code of Criminal Procedure (CrPC) safeguards, including two independent witnesses. Seizures violating due-process are quashed.
supreme_court_benchmark.relevance_to_ai_engine: Demonstrates that even designated government officers cannot casually issue binding enforcement notices. An AI system has zero statutory appointment and cannot issue legal notices. The tool MUST be framed as a pre-inspection evidence-screening assistant.
